title: Kicky Peppery German Yautia Fried Rice
description: A peppery and festive German dish featuring yautia, this low-carb friendly fried rice is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It combines the unique texture of yautia with the crunch of peppers and onions.
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook until it is tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced yautia and cook until it is tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower rice to the skillet, stirring to combine with the yautia and vegetables.
Add the black pepper and salt, stirring to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the grated german cheese until it is melted and well combined.
Serve the kicky peppery german yautia fried rice hot.
